_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: Make a joyful noise to the Lord, all the earth.
Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good.
Bring the first fruits of the ground and set them before God.
Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good.
Rejoice in the Lord always; the Lord is near.
Come, let us worship. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Set down the basket of first fruits and look back over the road that brought you here.
Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good!
We were wanderers and strangers, and God made for us a place and a plenty.
Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good!
Do not be anxious for anything; in everything, by prayer with thanksgiving, come to God.
Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good!
For Christ is the bread that does not run out; come to him and rejoice — and again, rejoice.
Give thanks to the Lord, for his love endures forever!

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: Set down the first fruits; look back over the road.
Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good.
We were wanderers; God gave us a place and plenty.
Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good.
Christ is the bread that never runs out; rejoice.
Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good. Amen.
